title: ByteWolf Vision Health v0.1
description: A snapshot of one camera/vision stream's health, so a consumer can tell a live, healthy feed from a stalled or degraded one before trusting its detections. Observation-only; carries its own freshness. See brain/vision/canonical.py.

contract_version.description: Pins the meaning of every field below.

source.description: The stream this health is about, e.g. 'camera:front_rgb'.

observed_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC, with an offset. When this snapshot was taken; age is measured from here.

max_age_s.description: How long this snapshot stays usable. Past it the health is stale and must not be treated as current.

validity.description: 'valid': the producer trusts this snapshot. 'invalid': measured but not trusted. 'missing': the stream could not be probed.

state.description: The stream's health. 'unknown' is a legitimate answer before a probe runs; it is safe to state, a false 'healthy' is not.

fps.description: Frames per second the stream is currently delivering, if known.

backlog_frames.description: Frames queued and not yet processed. A growing backlog means the consumer is seeing the past, not the present.

dropped_frames.description: Frames dropped since the last snapshot. Dropped frames are reported, never silently hidden, because a gap in coverage is not free space.

model_id.description: The detector model attached to the stream, if any.

detail.description: Free text for audit, e.g. the reason for 'degraded'. Never parsed for dispatch.
